description: TZ-08 — Timezone (JST display) — Contract Start Date and End Date in the Contract List must be rendered in JST. A contract stored with Start Date = 2025-03-31T15:00:00Z (UTC) has a JST Start Date of 2025-04-01T00:00:00+09:00 and must display as 2025-04-01, not 2025-03-31.
preconditions:
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Riso Salesforce org
- A student (Contact) has a contract where Start Date is stored as 2025-03-31T15:00:00Z in the DB (= JST: 2025-04-01T00:00:00+09:00)
- Contract is for AY 2025-2026
- today = 2026-06-22; current_AY = 2025-2026
steps_actions:
1. Open the Contact record and click the Course tab
2. Locate the contract row in the Active tab Contract List
3. Observe the Start Date cell value
steps_result:
1. Course tab loads with the Active tab
2. The contract row is visible
3. Start Date displays 2025-04-01 (JST value), NOT 2025-03-31 (UTC value)
steps_data:
1. today = 2026-06-22; contract Start Date stored as UTC = 2025-03-31T15:00:00Z (= JST 2025-04-01T00:00:00+09:00)
2. Expected display: 2025-04-01 (JST); must NOT show 2025-03-31 (raw UTC date)
